statement_record.book: Lemma 5.6.1: a monadic functor U : A -> C reflects isomorphisms (is conservative). Proof: transport along the comparison equivalence to U^T : C^T -> C, and observe that if a T-algebra map f has an inverse of its underlying morphism in C, that inverse satisfies the algebra square and is therefore itself a T-algebra map.
statement_record.intree: em_forget_reflects_isos : ReflectsIsos (EM_Forget T), for every monad T on every base D — proved exactly by Riehl's argument (em_iso_inverse_commutes, BeckObjects.v:143, conjugates the algebra square with the inverse on both sides). Additionally creates_split_reflects_isos : CreatesUSplitCoequalizers U -> ReflectsIsos U for an arbitrary U, and equivalence_reflects_isos : ReflectsIsos F for any equivalence F.
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the book asserts conservativity of an ARBITRARY monadic U; in-tree the conclusion is available only at U = U^T (EM_Forget), for a U satisfying Beck's creation hypothesis, and for equivalences. `Monadic` is defined (Monad/Comparison.v:273, `Monadic U := ∃ F (A : F ⊣ U), EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A)`) and the identification U^T ◯ K ≈ U is proved (EM_Comparison_Forget, Monad/Comparison.v:198), yet no lemma glues them: ReflectsIsos is nowhere shown stable under composition or transportable along `≈` of functors.

gap: No in-tree theorem of the form `Monadic U -> ReflectsIsos U`. The three ingredients Riehl's proof needs all exist separately (em_forget_reflects_isos; equivalence_reflects_isos; EM_Comparison_Forget : EM_Forget ◯ EM_Comparison ≈ U at Monad/Comparison.v:198), but the two structural transport lemmas required to assemble them are missing: (a) ReflectsIsos of a composite G ◯ F from ReflectsIsos G and ReflectsIsos F (or from ReflectsIsos of the composite plus fullness/faithfulness of one leg), and (b) transport of ReflectsIsos along a natural isomorphism of functors. Consequently the general lemma is not derivable off the shelf, only its specialization at the Eilenberg-Moore forgetful functor.
